title: On the local stand an email address is enough to sign in: the page fills the code it shows and sends it once
steps: S1: render the login page with the local preview, type an address and submit; the door answers a local code.
S2: render the code step the server drew with a local code.
S3: render the plain login page, type an address and submit.
expect: S1: one /login, then exactly one /verify with the shown code, then the page goes to next.
S2: one /verify with that code on load, then next.
S3: only /login; nothing is verified without a person.
fence: pages.js fillLocalCode through spread(), only when #local-code carries a code (LOCAL_LOGIN_PREVIEW)

tests: on the local stand an address is enough: the shown code is filled and sent, and the page goes on
a code page the server drew with the local code signs in on load
without the local preview the code step waits for a person
